finding.claim: Webhook SSRF guard does not block the CGNAT range 100.64.0.0/10 (also present in internal/webhook/webhook.go:318 and internal/alerts/sinks.go:140), so any authenticated operator can make the server POST to internal addresses in that range and observe HTTP status codes.
finding.source: Any authenticated operator (role user allowed) calling POST /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions with a url pointing at a 100.64.0.0/10 address; allow_private is not set.
finding.sink: Outbound HTTP POST from the server to attacker-chosen internal address (internal/webhook/webhook.go:281 via guarded client at 295-297).

trace.note: handleCreateWebhookSubscription decodes req.URL from the JSON body.
allow_private is admin-gated, so a non-admin request has AllowPrivate=false.
hostIsPrivate checks IsLoopback/IsPrivate/IsLinkLocal/IsUnspecified; netip IsPrivate covers only RFC1918 and fc00::/7, so 100.64.x.x passes.
Subscription is stored with OwnerOperatorID = caller and AllowPrivate=false.
Delivery target built from sub.URL with AllowPrivate from the stored row.
deliver builds a POST request to tgt.URL.
AllowPrivate false selects the guarded client (d.guarded).
Dialer Control hook runs on the resolved literal IP before connect.
isBlockedAddr does not match 100.64.0.0/10, so the connection proceeds.
Status >=400 yields error 'endpoint returned HTTP %d', recorded via record() at lines 265/274; visibility to the owner not verified.

finding.guards_checked: Admin-only allow_private (api/webhooks.go:73,127); scheme and host validation (config/server.go:193-198); DNS-resolution-time dialer address check (webhook.go:329-343, covers DNS rebinding); per-redirect-hop re-dial with 10-hop cap (webhook.go:348-353); 10s timeout; response body discarded (webhook.go:303); ownership on get/update/delete via loadOwnedWebhookSub. Gap: 100.64.0.0/10 not in the blocked set; NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 not unmapped. Severity low (blind SSRF with status oracle, needs internal services in that range). Unverified at runtime: no shell available to run Go tests or a PoC.
